title: Incident detection errors may delay or misdirect response
risk_scenario: If automatic incident detection misses a real incident or generates an incorrect detection, incident information may be delayed, misclassified or acted on inappropriately, potentially affecting response.
cause_or_condition: The specification describes automatic detection using AI video analytics, IoT sensors and existing municipal events, but detection categories, operating conditions, error rates and acceptance criteria are not established; the need for human review before action requires verification.
potential_consequence: Delayed or inappropriate operational response, potentially contributing to serious harm or major disruption during an urban incident or emergency.
affected_stakeholders: Residents, tourists, incident reporters, emergency responders and municipal services
inherent_impact_rationale: Major: a missed or incorrect detection in a public-safety incident could contribute to delayed or inappropriate response and serious harm or major disruption. This is a plausible consequence, not evidence of an event that occurred.
inherent_likelihood_rationale: Not assessable from the reviewed specification: no detection error rates, validated performance results or sufficiently defined operating conditions are available.
likelihood_context_and_timeframe: The intended context is real-time incident management; actual deployment, operating exposure, incident mix, model configuration and review workflow are unverified.
documented_controls: The specification describes automatic incident detection and general testing/model-evaluation requirements (SRC-009, SRC-023, SRC-024). These are requirements, not verified operational safeguards.
control_status: Specified at requirement level; implementation and effectiveness unverified
control_evidence_and_limitations: No implementation or configuration evidence, function-specific acceptance thresholds, evaluation results, false-positive/false-negative rates or operational review evidence are available in the reviewed material.
residual_assessment_status: Not assessable from current evidence; relevant control implementation and effectiveness are unverified.
additional_evidence_required: Obtain implementation/configuration and test evidence; define detection categories and acceptance thresholds; evaluate false positives and false negatives across relevant conditions; verify human review, escalation, override and ongoing monitoring.
proposed_response: Require evidence of validated detection performance and documented human-review/escalation controls before relying on automated detection for consequential operational actions; define and test fallback and override procedures.
priority_rationale: A potentially serious public-safety consequence is plausible and key performance and oversight evidence remains unknown. High is a priority for evidence collection, not a claim that the event is likely or that harm has occurred.

title: Unverified authorisation and override arrangements for automated protocols
risk_scenario: If the deployed workflow does not provide effective authorisation, review, override and escalation arrangements for automated protocols and multichannel alerts, an inappropriate activation or failure to intervene could lead to a disproportionate, delayed or misdirected operational response.
cause_or_condition: The specification describes automated multi-area protocols for priority incidents and multichannel alerts, but the exact triggering conditions, relationship to AI-generated information, authorisation gates, override and failure handling, and responsible roles require verification.
potential_consequence: An inappropriate activation could divert response resources, confuse affected people or disrupt coordination; failure to review or stop an unsuitable action could delay an appropriate response and potentially contribute to serious harm.
affected_stakeholders: Residents, tourists, incident reporters, emergency responders and municipal services
inherent_impact_rationale: Major: inappropriate or insufficiently reviewed protocol activation in a public-safety context could materially disrupt response or contribute to serious harm. This is a plausible consequence, not evidence that an activation error has occurred.
inherent_likelihood_rationale: Not assessable from the reviewed specification: evidence does not establish actual trigger conditions, operational frequency, authorisation workflow or incident history.
likelihood_context_and_timeframe: The specification describes priority-incident protocols and multichannel alerts, but the deployed workflow, use of AI outputs, human review and operating exposure are unverified.
documented_controls: The specification describes automated multi-area protocols for priority incidents and multichannel alerts (SRC-008). This documents a capability, not an effective oversight control.
control_status: Human authorisation, review, override, failure handling and escalation arrangements are unverified; control effectiveness cannot be assessed.
control_evidence_and_limitations: No implementation or operational evidence has been reviewed for the relevant authorisation, review, override and escalation arrangements; general test-plan requirements do not establish that these controls were implemented or tested.
residual_assessment_status: Not assessable from current evidence; relevant oversight controls and their effectiveness are unverified.
additional_evidence_required: Obtain workflow and role documentation; identify which events or outputs can trigger each protocol and channel; verify approval gates, human review, override/cancellation, fallback handling, escalation responsibilities and logs; review test and incident records.
proposed_response: Define and validate proportionate authorisation and review rules for consequential protocol activations, provide operational override and fallback mechanisms, assign accountable roles, and test normal, erroneous and degraded scenarios.
priority_rationale: Potentially serious consequences are plausible in a public-safety context, while the authorisation and override workflow remains unverified. High is a priority for evidence collection, not a claim that an error is likely or that the controls are absent.

title: Unreliable predictive analytics may misdirect public-safety planning or response
risk_scenario: If predictive outputs are inaccurate, poorly calibrated or misunderstood, public-safety resources or attention may be directed toward the wrong locations, periods or incidents.
cause_or_condition: The specification describes predictive analytics using historical incidents, seasonal patterns, environmental conditions, GIS and video-surveillance information, but does not establish specific prediction targets, model evaluation results, uncertainty communication or approved operational limits.
potential_consequence: Misallocation of resources, failure to prepare for a material incident, or inappropriate operational prioritisation, potentially contributing to serious disruption or harm.
affected_stakeholders: Residents, tourists, emergency responders, municipal operators and services
inherent_impact_rationale: Major: inaccurate predictions used in public-safety planning could materially misdirect resources or readiness and contribute to serious consequences. This describes a plausible scenario, not observed performance or harm.
inherent_likelihood_rationale: Not assessable from the reviewed specification: prediction targets, validation results, operating exposure and decision-use rules are not sufficiently established to estimate likelihood.
likelihood_context_and_timeframe: The intended function supports proactive public-safety action, but the actual model, prediction horizon, operational use, input allocation and frequency of reliance are unverified.
documented_controls: The specification describes predictive analytics and general requirements for model evaluation, metrics/thresholds and maintenance (SRC-007, SRC-024). These requirements are not evidence of function-specific validation or effective controls.
control_status: Evaluation and monitoring controls are specified at a general or requirement level; implementation and effectiveness for the predictive function are unverified.
control_evidence_and_limitations: No function-specific validation report, approved performance thresholds, calibration results, uncertainty presentation, data-suitability analysis or monitoring/retraining records have been reviewed.
residual_assessment_status: Not assessable from current evidence; implementation and effectiveness of predictive-model controls are unverified.
additional_evidence_required: Obtain the model purpose and target definitions; approved evaluation metrics and thresholds; representative validation results; input/data-quality and drift analyses; operator guidance; monitoring, maintenance and change-control records.
proposed_response: Define prediction purpose and permitted use; validate performance against approved thresholds; communicate uncertainty and limitations to operators; monitor drift and operational outcomes; require review before predictions drive consequential priorities.
priority_rationale: Potentially serious public-safety consequences are plausible, while prediction targets, validation and use constraints remain unverified. High is the priority for evidence collection, not a claim that predictions are likely to be wrong.

title: Incorrect event correlation may combine, duplicate or misclassify incident information
risk_scenario: If the event-correlation function incorrectly links unrelated reports, fails to link reports about the same event, or handles conflicting and delayed source data poorly, operators may receive a misleading incident picture.
cause_or_condition: The specification describes AI correlation across sensors, cameras, social networks, GESPOL and other municipal systems, including grouping related incidents and avoiding duplicates, but the correlation mechanism, data provenance, conflict handling and performance criteria are not established.
potential_consequence: Incident records may be duplicated, incorrectly grouped or omitted, potentially distorting classification, prioritisation, escalation or coordination.
affected_stakeholders: Residents, tourists, incident reporters, emergency responders and municipal services
inherent_impact_rationale: Moderate: inaccurate correlation could meaningfully degrade the operational picture and contribute to poor coordination; the reviewed evidence does not establish that every correlation error would cause major harm.
inherent_likelihood_rationale: Not assessable from the reviewed specification: no correlation accuracy results, defined event-matching criteria or operating data are available to support a likelihood estimate.
likelihood_context_and_timeframe: The specification describes multiple source types and bidirectional GESPOL integration, but actual data quality, latency, source availability, correlation logic and operational reliance are unknown.
documented_controls: The specification describes AI event correlation and general integration/testing requirements (SRC-006, SRC-004, SRC-023). These are not evidence of tested correlation quality, source lineage or effective error handling.
control_status: Capability and general test requirements are specified; the correlation mechanism, implementation and effectiveness are unverified.
control_evidence_and_limitations: No design description, event-matching rules, conflict/duplicate handling procedures, source-provenance evidence, representative test results or operational correction records have been reviewed.
residual_assessment_status: Not assessable from current evidence; implementation and effectiveness of correlation and data-quality controls are unverified.
additional_evidence_required: Obtain the correlation design and event definitions; document sources and lineage; review handling of duplicate, conflicting, incomplete and delayed events; inspect representative test cases/results and correction/escalation procedures.
proposed_response: Define and test event-matching and conflict-resolution rules; preserve source provenance; monitor false links and missed links; provide operators with correction and escalation mechanisms; document limitations and fallback procedures.
priority_rationale: Event correlation supports public-safety incident awareness, while its logic and error handling remain unverified. High is a priority for evidence collection because misleading correlation could affect operational decisions, not a claim that errors are likely.

title: Public-safety information reused for CRM personalisation without adequately evidenced safeguards
risk_scenario: If incident-related information or interactions are incorporated into unified CRM profiles and used for personalisation or awareness/loyalty campaigns without clearly defined purposes, data boundaries and safeguards, information collected in a public-safety context may be reused in ways affected people do not expect or that are not appropriately limited.
cause_or_condition: The specification describes feeding safety-related incidents and interactions into a unified CRM profile for personalisation and awareness or loyalty campaigns; the exact data fields, processing arrangements, legal basis, access boundaries, retention and restrictions on reuse are not established by the reviewed passage.
potential_consequence: Unexpected or excessive reuse of personal information, loss of trust, inappropriate profiling or disclosure, and potential interference with individuals' privacy or expectations when seeking or reporting safety assistance.
affected_stakeholders: Residents, tourists, incident reporters, CRM users and municipal services
inherent_impact_rationale: Major: safety-related interaction data linked to profiles and campaign purposes could create a significant privacy or trust impact if purposes and safeguards are inadequate. This is a plausible scenario, not a finding that data are unlawfully processed.
inherent_likelihood_rationale: Not assessable from the reviewed specification: data flows, actual fields, processing context and safeguards are unverified, and the source does not support a likelihood estimate.
likelihood_context_and_timeframe: The specified relationship concerns incident reporting and the CRM/fidelity module, but live data transfer, the data categories involved, scale of processing and actual user-facing practices are unknown.
documented_controls: The specification describes a cross-module relationship between safety-related incidents/interactions and CRM profiles used for personalisation and campaigns (SRC-010), and incident reporting through the tourist app/website (SRC-005). These requirements do not establish that privacy safeguards are absent or ineffective.
control_status: Purpose limitation, data minimisation, access boundaries, retention, transparency and any separation between public-safety and campaign uses are unverified in the reviewed material.
control_evidence_and_limitations: No data-flow specification, field-level mapping, purpose/legal-basis assessment, transparency material, access matrix, retention schedule or evidence of controls over campaign reuse has been reviewed.
residual_assessment_status: Not assessable from current evidence; the processing design and effectiveness of related safeguards are unverified.
additional_evidence_required: Obtain the cross-module data-flow and field mappings; document purposes, roles, lawful basis and transparency arrangements; inspect access controls, retention/deletion rules, minimisation and separation of public-safety data from campaign use; confirm approval and audit trails for any reuse.
proposed_response: Define and document permitted purposes and fields for cross-module transfers; limit access and retention; prevent campaign reuse unless specifically justified and appropriately authorised; provide clear transparency and demonstrate the implemented safeguards.
priority_rationale: The proposed relationship creates a material purpose-limitation and trust question, while key data fields, safeguards and operational arrangements remain unknown. High is a priority for evidence collection, not a conclusion of unlawful processing.

title: Video and drone data may be captured or retained without sufficiently evidenced access and lifecycle controls
risk_scenario: If camera or drone footage and associated telemetry are captured, accessed, exported, retained or reused without suitable purpose, access, retention and review controls, individuals may be monitored or their information exposed beyond the intended operational need.
cause_or_condition: The specification requires PTZ and fixed cameras, video recording, encrypted export and a minimum 30-day local video storage period for critical channels, and describes drone video, telemetry and AI-enabled analytics; actual configuration, authorised uses, access permissions, retention/deletion practices and safeguards are not verified.
potential_consequence: Unnecessary or excessive monitoring, unauthorised access or disclosure of footage, retention beyond approved needs, or use of captured information outside the intended public-safety context, affecting privacy and trust.
affected_stakeholders: Residents, tourists, bystanders, incident reporters, operators and municipal services
inherent_impact_rationale: Major: video and aerial sensing in public spaces can create significant privacy consequences if use, access or retention is not appropriately controlled. This is a plausible consequence, not evidence of excessive or unlawful surveillance.
inherent_likelihood_rationale: Not assessable from the reviewed specification: actual capture patterns, configuration, access practices, retention enforcement and operational use are not established.
likelihood_context_and_timeframe: The source specifies camera and drone capabilities and video retention requirements, but the real deployment, capture areas, enabled analytics, footage access, export practices, deletion routines and operational exposure remain unknown.
documented_controls: The specification includes access restrictions for the application server, encrypted video export and a minimum 30-day local storage requirement for critical channels (SRC-015, SRC-016, SRC-022). The existence of requirements does not prove implementation or adequacy for each data category and use.
control_status: Equipment, storage and certain security requirements are specified; actual access permissions, retention settings, deletion controls, drone operating procedures and safeguard effectiveness are unverified.
control_evidence_and_limitations: No as-built camera/drone configuration, access matrix, retention/deletion evidence, export/access logs, operating procedures, data-protection assessment or commissioning evidence has been reviewed.
residual_assessment_status: Not assessable from current evidence; actual data-capture configuration and safeguard operation are unverified.
additional_evidence_required: Obtain deployment locations and enabled analytics; confirm purpose and necessity for capture; inspect access and export permissions, logging, retention/deletion configuration and monitoring; establish drone deployment/authorisation procedures and how footage and telemetry are handled; review commissioning evidence.
proposed_response: Set and document purpose-based access and retention controls; restrict exports; ensure access and events are logged and reviewed; document procedures for drone deployment and data handling; verify settings and deletion through configuration evidence and tests.
priority_rationale: The combination of fixed, PTZ and aerial sensing creates potentially significant privacy consequences, while deployed configuration and lifecycle safeguards remain unverified. High prioritises evidence collection and does not assert a control failure or unlawful surveillance.

title: Security or integration weaknesses may compromise system integrity or availability
risk_scenario: If interfaces between Public Safety and connected municipal systems are incorrectly configured, insufficiently protected or inadequately monitored, unauthorised activity or integration failures could affect the confidentiality, integrity or availability of information used in public-safety operations.
cause_or_condition: The specification requires bidirectional GESPOL integration, secure documented APIs, centralised audit logging and security testing, but the implemented interface configuration, access controls, monitoring coverage and test results have not been verified.
potential_consequence: Unauthorised access, altered or unavailable incident information, disrupted integrations, or reduced ability to investigate and respond to security events.
affected_stakeholders: Residents, tourists, incident reporters, municipal operators, emergency responders and connected municipal services
inherent_impact_rationale: Major: a material security or integration failure could compromise operational information or disrupt public-safety coordination. This is a plausible consequence, not evidence of a vulnerability or incident.
inherent_likelihood_rationale: Not assessable from the reviewed specification: there is no implementation evidence, security test result or operational incident data from which to estimate likelihood.
likelihood_context_and_timeframe: The module is intended to exchange information with connected municipal systems. Actual interfaces, network exposure, permissions, deployed configuration, monitoring coverage and incident history remain unknown.
documented_controls: The specification requires secure documented APIs, bidirectional GESPOL integration, centralised logs and security testing (SRC-004, SRC-013, SRC-021, SRC-023). These requirements do not establish effective implementation.
control_status: Security, integration and logging controls are specified at requirement level; implementation and effectiveness are unverified.
control_evidence_and_limitations: No interface specifications, deployed access-control configuration, integration test results, security assessment, log-monitoring evidence or remediation records have been reviewed.
residual_assessment_status: Not assessable from current evidence; actual control implementation and effectiveness are unverified.
additional_evidence_required: Obtain interface and network documentation; review authentication, authorisation, data validation and error handling; inspect security and integration test results; verify logging coverage, protection against log tampering, alerting and remediation processes.
proposed_response: Implement and verify appropriately protected interfaces, least-privilege access, monitored security logging and tested integration failure handling; document accountable owners and resolve material findings before operational reliance.
priority_rationale: Connected-system dependencies and the public-safety purpose make a material failure potentially consequential, while implementation and testing evidence remain unavailable. High is an evidence-collection priority, not a claim that a security incident or control failure has occurred.

title: Backup, recording or recovery failures may interrupt public-safety operations or remove needed evidence
risk_scenario: If recording, backup or recovery arrangements fail or cannot restore usable information when needed, operators may lose access to video evidence, incident records or supporting information during an outage or emergency.
cause_or_condition: The specification requires redundant local video recording, 24/7 operation with fault tolerance, scheduled backups, secure storage, documented restoration procedures and periodic restoration tests, but the deployed configuration and test results are unverified.
potential_consequence: Loss or unavailability of operational information, delayed incident handling, reduced ability to reconstruct events, or prolonged disruption to public-safety services.
affected_stakeholders: Municipal operators, emergency responders, residents, tourists and services relying on incident information
inherent_impact_rationale: Major: loss of important video or incident information during an emergency could materially disrupt response and subsequent investigation. This is a plausible consequence, not evidence of an actual failure.
inherent_likelihood_rationale: Not assessable from the reviewed specification: implementation, system dependency, recovery-test outcomes and actual outage history are unavailable.
likelihood_context_and_timeframe: The specification describes 24/7 public-safety operations and storage/backup requirements, but actual service dependencies, failure exposure, backup coverage, restoration performance and recovery arrangements remain unknown.
documented_controls: The specification requires redundant local video recording, fault tolerance, scheduled backups, encryption, documented restoration procedures and periodic restoration tests (SRC-015, SRC-019, SRC-020). These are requirements, not proof of successful recovery.
control_status: Resilience and recovery controls are specified; implementation, recovery performance and effectiveness are unverified.
control_evidence_and_limitations: No as-built resilience design, backup configuration, retention mapping, restoration-test results, recovery objectives or evidence of recovery exercises have been reviewed.
residual_assessment_status: Not assessable from current evidence; implementation and effectiveness of backup, recording and recovery controls are unverified.
additional_evidence_required: Obtain architecture and dependency documentation; inspect backup schedules and coverage, storage protection, retention requirements, restoration procedures, test results, recovery objectives and fault-handling records; verify how failures are detected and escalated.
proposed_response: Verify redundancy and backup coverage; perform and document restoration tests against approved recovery objectives; define recovery responsibilities and escalation; monitor failures and periodically review recovery readiness.
priority_rationale: A loss of essential information or prolonged interruption could have serious operational consequences, while recovery capability remains unverified. High is a priority for obtaining evidence, not a claim that an outage or data loss is likely.

title: AI performance degradation may go undetected during operation
risk_scenario: If the performance of detection, correlation or predictive functions degrades over time and that degradation is not identified promptly, operators may continue relying on outputs whose quality no longer meets operational needs.
cause_or_condition: The specification requires model-evaluation metrics and acceptable thresholds, documentation of assumptions affecting continued validity, maintenance/retraining activities and operational KPIs, but the selected thresholds, model-specific monitoring arrangements and results are not established.
potential_consequence: Reduced reliability of incident awareness or prediction, potentially leading to poorly targeted resources, delayed response or continued reliance on unsuitable AI outputs.
affected_stakeholders: Residents, tourists, incident reporters, municipal operators, emergency responders and services
inherent_impact_rationale: Major: undetected degradation in a public-safety function could materially reduce the quality of incident awareness or operational planning and contribute to serious disruption or harm. This is a plausible consequence, not evidence of actual degradation.
inherent_likelihood_rationale: Not assessable from the reviewed specification: there are no model-specific baseline results, ongoing monitoring results, operational exposure data or defined degradation history to support a likelihood estimate.
likelihood_context_and_timeframe: The specification contemplates public-safety operations and general model evaluation/maintenance, but the deployed configuration, monitoring frequency, relevant operating conditions and reliance on model outputs are unverified.
documented_controls: The specification describes operational KPIs and general requirements for model metrics, validity assumptions, maintenance/retraining and testing (SRC-011, SRC-023, SRC-024). These are requirements, not evidence that suitable monitoring operates.
control_status: Monitoring and model-lifecycle requirements are specified at general level; implementation and effectiveness for each function are unverified.
control_evidence_and_limitations: No approved function-specific thresholds, baseline evaluations, monitoring dashboards/alerts, drift analyses, maintenance records or evidence of review and corrective action have been reviewed.
residual_assessment_status: Not assessable from current evidence; implementation and effectiveness of ongoing monitoring and model-lifecycle controls are unverified.
additional_evidence_required: Obtain approved model-specific metrics and thresholds; baseline and ongoing evaluation results; monitoring frequency and alert rules; data/operational drift analyses; responsible review roles; maintenance, retraining and corrective-action records.
proposed_response: Define function-specific performance indicators and review thresholds; monitor for degradation and data/operational drift; assign review ownership; trigger investigation, restriction or revalidation when thresholds are breached; retain evidence of corrective actions.
priority_rationale: Potentially serious operational consequences are plausible, while the effectiveness of ongoing monitoring and maintenance remains unverified. High is a priority for obtaining evidence, not a claim that degradation has occurred or is likely.

title: AI-related incidents and material changes may not be consistently investigated or controlled
category: AI governance / incident management / change accountability
risk_scenario: If an AI-related failure, unexpected output or material change occurs without a sufficiently documented and implemented process for reporting, triage, investigation, approval, rollback and follow-up, the issue may remain unresolved or recur without clear accountability.
cause_or_condition: The specification requires centralised audit logging, a test plan and model maintenance/retraining activities, but the AI-related incident process, change approval responsibilities, impact assessment, rollback criteria and evidence of implementation are not established for the Public Safety functions.
potential_consequence: Delayed correction, recurrence of known issues, changes introduced without adequate evaluation, and insufficient traceability of decisions or accountability, potentially affecting service reliability and public-safety operations.
affected_stakeholders: Residents, tourists, incident reporters, municipal operators, emergency responders, system owners and suppliers
inherent_impact_rationale: Moderate: weak incident and change processes could delay investigation or correction and allow issues to recur, degrading service reliability and accountability. More serious outcomes are possible depending on the incident, but are not assumed as the baseline consequence here.
inherent_likelihood_rationale: Not assessable from the reviewed specification: no operational history or evidence about actual AI incident frequency, change practices or response effectiveness is available.
likelihood_context_and_timeframe: The specification describes AI/model-related functions and general audit, test and maintenance requirements; the deployed incident-handling and change processes, responsible owners and operational exposure are unknown.
documented_controls: The specification requires centralised logs and traceability of activity, a comprehensive test plan, and model maintenance/retraining activities (SRC-021, SRC-023, SRC-024). These do not establish that a complete AI-related incident and change-control process is operating.
control_status: Logging, testing and model-lifecycle requirements are specified; function-specific incident management, change accountability and effectiveness remain unverified.
control_evidence_and_limitations: No incident taxonomy or reporting workflow, triage/escalation procedure, accountable owner map, change approval record, impact assessment, rollback procedure or post-incident review evidence has been reviewed.
residual_assessment_status: Not assessable from current evidence; implementation and effectiveness of AI-related incident and change-management controls are unverified.
additional_evidence_required: Obtain incident management and change-control procedures; confirm accountable roles, severity criteria, escalation and notification routes; inspect incident records, model/configuration changes, approval and validation evidence, rollback plans and post-incident reviews.
proposed_response: Define and assign an AI-related incident process and change-control responsibilities; require risk and impact review, appropriate testing/approval and rollback planning for material changes; investigate incidents, track corrective actions and retain auditable records.
priority_rationale: Governance processes need verification, but this risk is primarily about the ability to detect, investigate and correct issues and does not independently establish that a high-impact failure has occurred. Moderate prioritises structured evidence collection and process review.

title: External data-source quality or provenance may distort analysis if sources are used by Public Safety
category: Data quality / external dependency / analytical validity
risk_scenario: If external tourism, mobility, crime or other indicators are incorporated into Public Safety analysis without adequate provenance, freshness, suitability and quality checks, the resulting analysis or prioritisation may be misleading.
cause_or_condition: Annex I lists external data sources and indicators for integration into PIDM, but does not establish which of those sources connect to Module #32. SRC-012 also notes that source ownership, provenance and quality controls are not fully established.
potential_consequence: If such data are used in Public Safety processes, stale, inaccurate, mismatched or poorly understood indicators could distort risk analysis, resource planning or operational priorities.
affected_stakeholders: Residents, tourists, incident reporters, municipal analysts, operators and emergency responders
inherent_impact_rationale: Moderate: if external indicators influence Public Safety analysis, poor data quality or provenance could materially mislead interpretation or prioritisation. The connection is conditional and no downstream harm is established.
inherent_likelihood_rationale: Not assessable from the reviewed documentation: the connection of Annex I sources to Module #32, the actual data used, source quality and operating exposure are not established.
likelihood_context_and_timeframe: The specification lists external indicators for PIDM and separately describes Public Safety predictive analytics and data sources. Whether Annex I sources enter Module #32, and at what frequency or granularity, remain unknown.
documented_controls: Annex I lists sources and indicators for PIDM integration (SRC-025), and SRC-012 records data sources and outputs for Public Safety. These descriptions do not establish that Annex I sources feed Module #32 or that data-quality controls are effective.
control_status: Connection of the listed external sources to Module #32 is unverified; data provenance, freshness, suitability and quality controls for any such integration are also unverified.
control_evidence_and_limitations: No interface mapping, source lineage, data dictionary, freshness/quality thresholds, validation results, ownership information or monitoring evidence has been reviewed for a connection between Annex I sources and Public Safety.
residual_assessment_status: Not assessable from current evidence; the integration itself and relevant data-quality controls remain unverified.
additional_evidence_required: Obtain Module #32 interface mappings and source lineage; establish whether Annex I sources are used; if so, identify source owners, fields, refresh frequency, quality/freshness checks, transformations, validation rules and monitoring.
proposed_response: Do not assume Annex I sources feed Public Safety. If an integration is confirmed, document its purpose and lineage, assign data ownership, define suitability and freshness criteria, validate transformations, monitor quality and document limitations before relying on the indicators.
priority_rationale: The link between Annex I and Module #32 is not established, so the risk is conditional. Moderate prioritises clarifying the dependency and assessing controls if the integration exists, without asserting that the data are currently used or unreliable.
